name: aolangai
description: See the quota and open sessions of all your Claude accounts in one place, and hand work to the one with the most left. macOS app and CLI.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/desktop
scripts.dist: rm -rf packages/core/dist packages/cli/dist && npm run build && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
